selection_rule: Minimize clean-control failures, then all development packet failures, then missing channel outputs, then aggregate channel BER; ties prefer alpha=1 and quantile=0.5. Combined uses independently selected component settings; no additional combined search.
evaluation_status: New front-end outcomes on later B/G batches have not been inspected at freeze time. Their baseline results and videos were previously inspected, so this is not a blind pristine holdout.
